headlines.title: Is Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Fully Valued After Its Recent Rally?
headlines.summary: Leadership transition and why it matters for Lumentum Holdings Lumentum Holdings (LITE) recently disclosed that Executive Vice President of Global Reliability & Quality Vincent Retort plans to retire in October 2026, while staying on as a consultant for two years. This arrangement keeps his reliability and quality expertise tied to the company through continued service, which may interest investors focused on execution risk as Lumentum supports AI and cloud infrastructure customers.

headlines.title: “The Bottleneck Isn’t the Chips Anymore”: Goldman Sachs Says These Are AI’s Next Big Winners
headlines.summary: A Goldman Sachs executive says the AI trade is quietly shifting away from chips toward a different hardware category entirely, and two companies are already racing to fill a supply gap that could take years to close.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through two segments, Cloud & Networking and Industrial Tech. The Cloud & Networking segment offers optical and photonic chips, components, modules, and subsystems supplied to cloud data center operators, AI/ML infrastructure providers, and network equipment manufacturer customers that are building cloud data centers and network infrastructures. Its Industrial Tech segment provides short-pulse solid-state lasers, kilowatt-class fiber lasers, diode lasers, and gas lasers that serves the semiconductor device, solar cell, display, and electric vehicle and battery manufacturing markets. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
